display.purpose: Page H1, gold rule above, about 16ch in the hero.

headline.purpose: Section H2s in a two-column section head.

title.purpose: H3s, row, choice and service names.

label.purpose: Uppercase panel header bars, tile labels, footer heads, ticket and status labels.

figure.purpose: Prices, estimate tiles, totals; always tabular.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global :focus-visible; inputs use the outline at 0 offset with a night-blue border.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Reveals, nav underline, masthead tighten, panel-in.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Sections reveal on scroll down and hide again on scroll up; fade only under reduced motion.

motion.name: maya-flap
motion.purpose: Maya's seamless sprite flap; 1.6s under reduced motion; paused by html[data-motion=paused].

motion.name: cta-lift
motion.purpose: The one sanctioned Maya movement, on CTA hover/focus.

modes.name: high-contrast
modes.value: black ink and rules, #0033A0 action, #FFD400 gold, no shadows or guilloche, #FFF6B3 selected fills

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; background: #0A2552; border-top: 3px solid #F4C430; font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; color: #DCE6F7; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; padding: .78rem 1rem; transition: background-color .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 1rem; right: 1rem; bottom: 0; height: 3px; background: #F4C430; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .1); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-nav a:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .07); } .ds-nav a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(.35); } } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F4C430; outline-offset: -3px; }

narrative.overview:
MetroMaya is a Philippine LGU business-permits counter moved onto the web. It follows GOV.PH and eGovPH public-service conventions top to bottom: a dark notice strip carrying the prototype disclaimer and the accessibility tools (text size, high contrast, pause animations), a white masthead with an emblem, a deep blue navigation bar under a gold rule, sturdy bordered forms, and an institutional dark footer. It is clearly unofficial: the emblem is Maya's own head in a ringed badge, never a seal, the GOVPH mark or an agency logo.

The ground is white panels on cool government gray. Information is laid out the way a city hall prints it: fee schedules with striped rows, a computation sheet for the estimator, an office directory, numbered stations for the process, a permit stub for the confirmation. Density is moderate and plain; every screen is meant to work on a cheap phone in plain language. Maya, the sparrow mail carrier, is the guide beside forms and help. She is never the centrepiece.

The page refuses the startup-landing default: no giant slogan hero, no floating rounded card grids, no mascot hero.
keyCharacteristics: Notice strip, emblem masthead, blue nav bar with 3px gold top rule, dark footer with 4px gold top rule.
Schedules, sheets and directories (bordered panels with a gov-blue header bar) instead of card grids.
Gold is a rule, a focus ring and the sample-rate tag. It is never a fill for actions.
Guilloche security print on the hero's right edge and on the booking reference stub.
Three user-controlled modes on <html>: data-fs, data-contrast="high", data-motion="paused".

rules.name: The Gold Is A Rule Rule
rules.body: Gold draws lines, rings and tags. No button, panel or banner is filled gold. (.btn-gold exists in the stylesheet but no page uses it; it is not part of the system.)

rules.name: The Status Colors Rule
rules.body: Red and green appear only for state: errors, required marks, confirmed, cancelled, done. They are never decorative.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that is compared or totalled (fees, tiles, slot times, inspection meta) sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Body copy keeps proportional figures.

rules.name: The Mono For Codes Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is used only for booking reference numbers such as BPL-20261116-ABCDE.

rules.name: The Border First Rule
rules.body: A panel is defined by its 1px line-strong border and its gov-blue header bar. A shadow is optional and never stands in for a border.

dos: Do put the gold 44 by 4px rule above every H1 and section H2, and the 3px gold rule on the nav bar.
Do lay out fees, offices and steps as schedules, sheets, directories and numbered stations with header bars and ruled rows.
Do keep the "Sample rates" tag on every fee header and the sample-fee disclaimer visible in the footer and booking pages.
Do keep the "Prototype e-service, not an official government website" notice in the strip on every page.
Do place every :hover rule inside @media (hover: hover).
Do gate motion on prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference (press scale .96, hero rise, panel-in), with fade only under reduce, and honor html[data-motion="paused"] by pausing every animation.
Do reveal sections on scroll and hide them again on scroll back up.
Do check every new color and state in html[data-contrast="high"] and at html[data-fs="1"] and "2".
Do require consent before identity verification starts.
donts: Don't use the Republic of the Philippines seal, the GOVPH mark, or DICT or LGU logos, or anything implying endorsement.
Don't fill a button or panel with gold, or use red and green for decoration.
Don't use JetBrains Mono for anything but booking references.
Don't make Maya a hero centrepiece, scale her, move her, or crop her wings (beyond the CTA lift).
Don't add glow effects or a pill-shaped nav highlight.
Don't add kicker or eyebrow lines above headings.
